meta.name: publish
meta.description: Publish oh-my-opencode to npm by triggering the GitHub Actions publish workflow and verifying its artifacts. Ship-only: never runs pre-publish-review or re-reviews merged code unless the user explicitly asks. Argument: <patch|minor|major|explicit-semver>. Triggers: publish, release, deploy, npm publish.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把新版本发布到 npm 并确认发布成功
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果发布了新版本后需要确认它真正上线了
copy.tagline_en: Publish a new version to npm and confirm the release succeeded
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to ship a new version and verify it went live

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会替你走完整条发布流程:触发 GitHub Actions 发布工作流、轮询到结束,核实 GitHub release、npm 包与平台二进制包,起草增强版发行说明并发布到 Discord。
howto.when: 当你说出 “publish”、“release” 等关键词,或要求把包发布/部署到 npm 时接管;需要你给出 patch、minor、major 或明确版本号,没给会先追问。

say.note: 触发发布工作流并盯到跑完

say.text: 发布 minor 版本,lazycodex 也一起发

say.note: 按指定语义化版本发布

howto.what_en: Claude triggers the GitHub Actions publish workflow for oh-my-opencode, polls it to completion, verifies the GitHub release, npm packages and platform binaries, drafts the enhanced release notes, and posts a Discord announcement.
howto.when_en: Fires when you say "publish", "release" and similar keywords, or ask to ship the package to npm. It needs patch, minor, major or an explicit version; if none is given it asks first.

say_en.note: Triggers the publish workflow and follows it to the end

say_en.text: Publish a minor version, and ship lazycodex too
say_en.note: Verifies lazycodex-ai and the marketplace repo release
Publishes with an explicit semantic version
